nights.title: BOYNEXTDOOR
nights.name: BoyNextDoor
nights.extract: BoyNextDoor is a South Korean boy band formed by KOZ Entertainment in 2023. The group consists of six members: Sungho, Riwoo, Myung Jaehyun, Taesan, Leehan, and Woonhak. Characterized by its eponymous "boy next door" image, the group defines their work as easy listening with themes drawn from daily life.

nights.title: Chazz Palminteri: A Bronx Tale (5 and Over)
nights.name: Chazz Palminteri
nights.extract:
Calogero Lorenzo "Chazz" Palminteri is an American actor, producer, screenwriter, and playwright. He is best known for his film roles in A Bronx Tale (1993), based on his play of the same name, along with Bullets Over Broadway (1994) for which he was nominated for an Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor, and 
The Usual Suspects (1995).
His recent work includes his recurring role as Shorty in Modern Family (2010–2019).

His recent work includes a recurring role as Shorty in Modern Family (2010–2019).
facts: A Bronx Tale (1993) is based on his play of the same name.
He was nominated for an Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor for Bullets Over Broadway (1994).

de.who: Calogero Lorenzo "Chazz" Palminteri ist ein US-amerikanischer Schauspieler, Produzent, Drehbuchautor und Dramatiker. Bekannt ist er vor allem durch seine Filmrollen in A Bronx Tale (1993), das auf seinem gleichnamigen Theaterstück basiert, sowie in Bullets Over Broadway (1994) und The Usual Suspects (1995). Zuletzt hatte er eine wiederkehrende Rolle als Shorty in Modern Family (2010–2019).

Für Bullets Over Broadway (1994) war er für den Oscar als bester Nebendarsteller nominiert.

tr.who: Calogero Lorenzo "Chazz" Palminteri bir Amerikalı oyuncu, yapımcı, senarist ve oyun yazarıdır. En çok A Bronx Tale (1993) filmindeki rolleriyle tanınır; bu film kendi aynı adlı oyununa dayanır. Ayrıca Bullets Over Broadway (1994) ve The Usual Suspects (1995) filmlerinde de rol almıştır. Son dönemdeki işleri arasında Modern Family (2010–2019) dizisindeki Shorty rolü vardır.
facts: A Bronx Tale (1993), kendi aynı adlı oyununa dayanır.
Bullets Over Broadway (1994) ile En İyi Erkek Yardımcı Oyuncu dalında Akademi Ödülü'ne aday gösterilmiştir.

nights.title: Boston Manor
nights.name: Boston Manor
nights.extract: Boston Manor are a British rock band formed in Blackpool, Lancashire, England, in March 2013. They released a first EP, Here/Now, through Never Mend Records on Bandcamp, and in 2014 they signed with Failure By Design Records for their second EP, Driftwood. In 2015 the band signed with Pure Noise Records: with them, they released another EP, Saudade, as well as their full-length albums Be Nothing (2016), Welcome to the Neighbourhood (2018) and Glue (2020). The band's sound blends emo with heavier influences, reminiscent of '90s grunge and early 2000s post-hardcore. The band have been nominated for Best British Breakthrough at Kerrang! nights.title: Terrace Martin
nights.name: Terrace Martin
nights.extract: Terrace Jamahl Martin is an American musician, rapper, singer, and record producer. He is perhaps best known for producing records for several prominent artists in the music industry, including Kendrick Lamar, Snoop Dogg, the Game, Busta Rhymes, Stevie Wonder, Charlie Wilson, Raphael Saadiq and YG, among others. Martin is a multi-instrumentalist whose music production embodies funk, jazz, classical and soul. Martin released his sixth studio album, Velvet Portraits, on his label, Sounds of Crenshaw Records, through Ropeadope Records.

Seine Produktionen verbinden Funk, Jazz, Klassik und Soul.
facts: Er hat für mehrere bekannte Künstler der Musikbranche Platten produziert, darunter Kendrick Lamar und Snoop Dogg.

nights.title: Qendresa - SOLD OUT
nights.name: Qendresa
nights.extract: Qendresa is a British-Kosovar singer, songwriter, and producer from North West London. She is known for her self-produced electronic soul and personal songwriting. She has released two studio albums: Midnight Request Line (2020) and Londra (2024). She gained mainstream recognition in 2026 through her collaborations with Canadian rapper Drake across his albums Habibti and Maid of Honour.
